front.label: Front
front.desc: The Hyperliquid mark, your name, and your edition number.

front.label: Name
front.desc: Your .eth name. It stays off the card until you are eligible, then the laser writes it live, line by line, in passes that run left and right.

front.label: Hyperliquid shape
front.desc: The Hyperliquid mark built only from dots, each one a single laser pulse. Dot size follows a slow wave, so the shape catches light like brushed metal.

front.label: Number
front.desc: Your card out of 25, in dot matrix. The laser etches it right after your name.

back.label: Back
back.desc: Hyperliquid terms on the left, ENS terms on the right, with the logo x logo at the centre.

back.label: Logo x logo
back.desc: Hyperliquid India and ENS at the centre of the back, the only marks on it.

back.label: Hyperliquid words
back.desc: Hyperliquid terms and assets, from HyperCore and HyperEVM to perps, vaults and HIP-4. A few numbers sit among them: 1,000,000,000 max supply, 29.11.2024 and 31% to users.

back.label: ENS words
back.desc: ENS terms on the other half, from .eth and primary names to subnames, text records, ENSv2 and onchain DNS names.
